name: Qwen 3.8 Max Prime
description: Qwen 3.8 Max Prime is the high-speed edition of Qwen 3.8 Max, retaining its 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE architecture and full capabilities while delivering 1.5–2× higher output throughput. Built for coding, office automation, and long-running agent workflows, it supports autonomous multi-day development, professional knowledge work, and visual understanding with a 1M-token context window.
